description: Defines the PropagationArgumentEntry class which manages entity ID sets for propagation logic, including update mechanisms and conversion to TBEL arguments.

classes.name: PropagationArgumentEntry
classes.description: Manages entity ID sets for propagation, supports updates, and converts to TBEL arguments.

methods.name: PropagationArgumentEntry
methods.description: Default constructor initializing entity ID set and transient fields.

methods.name: PropagationArgumentEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing entity IDs from a list.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the argument entry type as PROPAGATION.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the set of entity IDs.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates the entity ID set based on another ArgumentEntry, handling additions, removals, and synchronization with DB.

methods.name: checkAdded
methods.description: Adds new entity IDs to the set, respecting entity limits, and tracks added IDs.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the entity ID set is empty.

methods.name: toTbelCfArg
methods.description: Converts the entity ID set to a TBEL CF argument.
